fieldValues.chose:
<!-- wg-report cycle=2026-10-31 group=wg:third-party-ready -->
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-30 11:30 to 2026-10-31 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: two open escalations, none new this cycle (both proposed earlier, both still unanswered).
- 21b6b4b7 (srs#236, P0, blocks-gate): field identity and naming rules are written in the spec but nothing enforces them. Options: enforce in the schema, enforce in a validator, or stop claiming them in the spec. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (it blocks a gate and the P0 issue cannot move).
- 864eaebf (srs#991): one heading-outline rule for every document, or opt-in per Composition (Door 3, amends an Accepted RFC). Recommendation A, audit downstream first. Action needed: decide. Urgency: low (draft only).
Also waiting on you: c7a8e0a2 (`note delete` refusing notes that Relations point at, srs-rust#1497, you merged it as option A; ratification only); needs-input on srs-rust#1491, #683, srs#928.

2. Decided within mandate: nothing ratified. The three PRs merged this cycle cite an ADR, a spec ruling or an issue ruling as mandate, not a group decision record, so no group decision was ready and no session was held.

3. Done: 3 group PRs merged by the delegated path, all with a quorum line (builder tpr-builder / reviewer tpr-reviewer, findings none): srs-rust#1539 (derived catalog cache persisted across CLI runs; mandate ADR-056 and your "settled on principle" on #1198), srs-rust#1538 (test pins the spec default order, #1132), srs-rust#1534 (refuse cross-field rules carrying another kind's property, I-96). Also srs-programme#379 (last cycle's report). srs-rust#1530 merged at 01:58 on 10-30, before this window.

4. Stuck or lost: 5 group-labelled PRs open (group-state counts 4).
- srs#991: waits on you (see 1).
- srs-rust#1540 (typed ErrorReport details, #1342): reviewer rejected, CI Lint red (cargo fmt diff in payload_contracts.rs). Needs the builder.
- srs-rust#1541 (find `fields` option, #1380): reviewer rejected, CI Test red at "Site CLI reference drift" (the new flag is missing from the site CLI reference). Needs the builder.
- srs-rust#1535 (reproduce out-of-enum fieldMeta.source, #1528): owner-merge, updated 04:46 today, no quorum line seen.
- srs-programme#382 (finding: an owner ruling in a PR comment did not reach c16c70c1 or srs-rust#1495): open, auto-merge.
srs-rust#1487 (red, rejected last cycle) did not show among recent group PRs; I did not confirm its state.

5. Budget: group-state reads 0 of 10 because its window rolled over at 11:30; counted from PRs, 3 delegated merges (srs-rust#1539, #1538, #1534, all gate:auto-merge), 6 room left. Open: 4 per group-state (incl. #991, #1535, #1540, #1541). Pause state: running.
5b. Awaiting ratification: 8487fd7a (arrangement fixture allowlist, age 4 days; PR merged without assent); c7a8e0a2 (note delete, age 3 days); 864eaebf (age 1 day); 21b6b4b7 (age 1 day). Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: **Queue running dry: 2 workable ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** Workable (ready, not blocked, parked or needs-input): srs-rust#1495 (P2; the rule says wait for a week of green) and srs#931 (P2, RFC needed). srs#236 (P0) is stopped on 21b6b4b7. Blocked: srs-rust#1496, #1339, srs-web#632. No local priorities set. Top 2 in the Builder's order: srs#931, srs-rust#1495. PRs in flight: 5; budget left 6. Possible sources: the spec-to-implementation drift list, the open exercises, unparking srs-rust#683 once its input is given. Waits on you: 21b6b4b7, 864eaebf, the ratifications in 5b. Fed by the analyst: 2026-10-30 12:19 (queue fed: filed 1, nominated 1, flow-stop findings 1).
6b. Exercises: three open, none listed in the SemanticOps log (the group's own): dd1a47a7 "Relation reads hide who asserted a link" (input: should reads carry createdBy, notes and meta, srs-rust#1411); 2ac083c0 "One unknown key makes a whole repository unloadable" (non-fatal diagnostic or fail-closed); 7131fe89 "Substrate entries: spec contract and schemas disagree". Build trigger: the logs hold well over 10 ratified decisions, so srs-web#560 is still ready to unpark; your call.

7. What we learned: the reviewer is holding the line on red gates (two rejects this cycle on formatting and generated-docs drift, both the kind a builder should catch before pushing), and delegated merges worked again (3 of 3 carried full quorum lines, the first cycle in a while with none missing). The queue is the constraint now: only 2 workable ready issues against a budget of 10. Measurement f5b58565 (I1): its window opened at 11:30 today (the group-state cycleStart rolls over at the close), so it covers no PRs and says nothing about this cycle: 0 of 0 grounded to a problem. Whether it is useful, noisy or misleading is yours to give in a session. I2 to I4: pending. Pattern to watch: the measure and group-state windows start at the close, so the close-time read always shows an empty cycle.
